notes.title: Update ACCELERATION
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735463/b60c0875b6edc15c4116b820bb392edc492f17da.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!
We are pleased to present you a new update, in which we have made the gameplay more dynamic and fast leveling progression. 
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735463/c14c4fd76d067aa0c537de3505440a0921adb769.jpg[/img]
- reduced damage from lasers of the last boss by 2 times

- when u kill last boos in horde game mode u get  x2 gold and supprot module

- reduced enemy projectile life time to 4 sec 

- added ability to skip weapon upg for 25 gold

- doubled the number of rerolls - now you get 4, and with each upgrade level, 2 more are added

- in horde game mode explosion radius increased per level: 10->30

- when leaving "run" in horde game mode you get all collected ressources

- in horde game mode hack&mine speed increased per level: 20->30

- on weapon level up name will be change color according to its rarity

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735463/f7a7346462c1e7c70162e7aabafbb7e797904403.jpg[/img]
List of changes 1.1.0.1:
1. The card for increasing experience has been corrected, it gave more additional experience than it had.
2. Added Turkish language.
3. Added a link to the discord channel in the main menu of the game
4. The logic for generating items has been redesigned, now items of lower rarity will be generated with lower values. Now the higher the rarity of the item, the better the parameters it will have. This change affects only the new items you receive, the old ones will remain unchanged.

notes.title: WEAPONS AND CARDS UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735463/44f442df649dba48ca945de09d3882d6b9ba130e.jpg[/img]
Hello, everyone.
As we promised, we are presenting you with a super update.
As promised, we have added 3 new weapons and [b]10 new skill cards[/b] for the gameplay.
One of the innovations is the ability to afterburner for the ship - (Shift).
New Weapons:
1. Shotgun
2. Gauss rifle
3. Light rocket launcher.

We wish you all a Happy New Year and a Merry Christmas.

notes.title: Big progression and balance update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735463/62d4921726f37ccd085b023d93209d48e4553764.jpg[/img]
Global changes have been made to the game's progression balance and economy.
Changes have been made to the length of missions, the number of enemies, and the speed of character leveling per session.
Added many small fixes to the gameplay
Changes made to achievements
Enjoy the game
